name: Wheat Rust
remedy: Remove heavily infected plants and apply a crop-safe fungicide according to its label.

name: Rice Blast
remedy: Use balanced nitrogen, improve field drainage, and apply a recommended rice blast treatment.

name: Cotton Leaf Curl
remedy: Control whiteflies, remove affected growth, and use certified resistant cotton varieties.

name: Early Blight
remedy: Apply a recommended fungicide, remove affected leaves, and improve airflow between plants.

name: Late Blight
remedy: Apply an appropriate fungicide immediately and remove infected plants.

name: Powdery Mildew
remedy: Remove heavily affected leaves and apply a suitable mildew treatment.
